description: Repair and replacement of existing windows, one new window to the rear elevation and works to the front and rear elevations and front forecourt.
decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted must be begun not later than the end of three years from the date of this permission.

Reason: In order to comply with the provisions of Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended).

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans: Site Location Plan; 152-EX00-00; 152-EX00-01; 152-EX06-00; 152-EX06-01; 152-EX07-00; 152-EX07-01; 152-EX08-00; 152-EX08-01; 152-EX09-00; 152-EX09-01; 152-EX10-00; 152-EX10-01; 152-EX11-00; 152-EX11-01; 152-OR-GA01-00; 152-OR-GA02-00; 152-OR-GA03-00; 152-OR-GA04; 152-PL2-GA01-00; 152-PL2-GA02-00; 152-PL2-GA03-00; 152-PL2-GA04-00; 152-PL2-GA05-00; 152-PL2-GA06-00; 152-PL2-GA07-00; 152-PL2-GA08-00; 152-PL2-GA09-00; 152-PL2-GA10-00; 152-PL2-GA11-00; TMH/ML/L/01; TMH/ML/L/02; Heritage Assessment of Windows & Existing Staircase from Nancy Gouldstone Architects dated February 2026 (x 18 pages).

Reason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interest of proper planning.
Condition : 3 - All new external work shall be carried out in materials that resemble, as closely as possible, in colour and texture those of the existing building, unless otherwise specified in the approved application. 

Reason: To safeguard the appearance of the premises and the character of the immediate area in accordance with the requirements of policies D1 and D2 of the London Borough of Camden Local Plan 2017. 
Condition : 4 - Before the relevant part of the work is begun, detailed drawings, or samples of materials as appropriate, in respect of the following, shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority: 

a) Plans, elevations and typical sections at a scale of 1:10 and 1:1/1:2 as appropriate, of all replacement and proposed windows (including jambs, head and cill). All should be annotated with materials and finishes.

b) Plans, elevations and sections at a scale of 1:10 of proposed fanlight, decorative sidelights and balustrade and details of external plasterwork, ornamental detailing and joinery.

The relevant part of the works shall be carried out in accordance with the details thus approved and all approved samples shall be retained on site during the course of the works. 

Reason:  To safeguard the appearance of the premises and the character of the immediate area in accordance with the requirements of policies D1 and D2 of the London Borough of Camden Local Plan 2017.
Condition : 5 - Plan, elevation drawings at a scale of 1:10 and typical plan, section and elevation details at a scale of 1:1/1:2, fully annotated with material and finishes of the proposed first floor Juliet balcony railings shall have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority, prior to commencement of the works. 

Reason: To safeguard the appearance of the premises and the character of the immediate area in accordance with the requirements of policies D1 and D2 of the London Borough of Camden Local Plan 2017.
Condition : 6 - All brickwork to the proposed extension shall be carried out in materials that resemble, as closely as possible, in terms of brick type, bond and pointing works those of the adjacent brickwork. 

Reason: To safeguard the appearance of the premises and the character of the immediate area in accordance with the requirements of policies D1 and D2 of the London Borough of Camden Local Plan 2017.
